main_text.p: Aut ἐπαναλήψει[?] ἢ ἀνακαινώσει fuafionis repe-titione seu renouatione. libr. 2. epistol. 18. libr. 4. epistol. 9. Aut αἰτιολογία, caufis inftitutæ fcriptionis. libr. 2. epist. 18. Aut ἀξιῶ[?] voto, vt dij approbent ac fortunent, quod Materiæ fuationum in Epistolis Cic. fam. amicus egerit.lib.2.epist.18.Sunt autem res & materiæ variæ,quæ in Cicero-nis Epiftolis fuaforiis reperiuntur.Suafio-nes demandationis officij. libr.2. epist.18. Reditus in patriam maturādi.libr.4.epist. 7.8.9.10.libr.7.epist.32. operæ principi alicui nauandæ.lib.7.epist.8.17. Vitandæ hominum frequentiæ quærendæque folitu-dinis.lib.9.epist.2. De Epistolis diffuasoriis.Neque de Diffuaforiis epistolis feorsim, & copiosè vt agamus, necesse habemus: cùm contrariorum eadem sit disciplina & ratio: nec labore ma-gno diffuadere foleant ij, qui quomodo suadendum sit, cognitum perspectumque habent. Sententiæ diffuasoriæ.Sumuntur enim hoc in genere Epistolarum sententiæ,vel à damno &periculo:vel inani & superuacaneo: vel difficili:vel turpi:vel temporis,loci,personarum conditione: vel cura,solicitudine,obtestatione liberorum, cognatorum, amicorum: vel aliorum iudicio & exemplis.Est etiam Collocatio in diffuasione obseruanda.collocatio in his ita instituenda, vt primò Exordium ponatur: constans, aut nostræ

page.notes: Catchword "pro" is set apart at the lower right and is therefore not in the text. Greek words ἐπαναλήψει and ἀξιῶ are read from a small scan and are doubtful. The margin notes are placed at the lines where they stand. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphen.
